hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southeastern Asia, islands between Malaysia and Indonesia || lowlying, gently undulating central plateau || focal point for Southeast Asian sea routes; consists of about 60 islands, the largest of which by far is Pulau Ujong; land reclamation has removed many former islands and created a number of new ones || Resources: fish, deepwater ports || Exports: integrated circuits, refined petroleum, machinery, vaccines, gold (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: lowlying, gently undulating central plateau || Southeastern Asia, islands between Malaysia and Indonesia

climate.excerpt: tropical; hot, humid, rainy; two distinct monsoon seasons - northeastern monsoon (December to March) and southwestern monsoon (June to September); inter-monsoon - frequent afternoon and early evening thunderstorms || flash floods

economy.excerpt: high-income, service-based economy; global financial hub; business-friendly policies and open to investment and trade; inflation easing but persistent in services; public investments in education, healthcare, and infrastructure; strong human capital development challenged by aging population || Exports: integrated circuits, refined petroleum, machinery, vaccines, gold (2023) || Industries: electronics, chemicals, financial services, oil drilling equipment, petroleum refining, biomedical products, scientific instruments, telecommunication equipment, processed food and beverages, ship repair, offshore platform construction, entrepot trade
